title: 120-MW Solar Power Plant in Aras Free Zone on Verge of Inauguration
text:
"120-MW Solar Power Plant in Aras Free Zone on Verge of Inauguration"

""
"The construction work on the 120-megawatt Aras Tarla Amin solar power plant in the Aras Free Zone, which began approximately one year ago, has recently been completed. The plant is now fully ready to be commissioned and connected to the national power grid.
